Change people's ideas at the root through patient teaching rather than attacking symbols.
Worship Allah unconditionally and meet hardship with perseverance so you do not lose both worlds.

15:1.ar: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
15:1.en: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading

15:2.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
15:2.en: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims

15:3.ar: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
15:3.en: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know

15:4.ar: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
15:4.en: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it

15:5.ar: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
15:5.en: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind

15:6.ar: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
15:6.en: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman

15:7.ar: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
15:7.en: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful

15:8.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذࣰ ا مُّنظَرِينَ
15:8.en: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated

15:9.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
15:9.en: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian

15:10.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
15:10.en: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old

15:11.ar: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
15:11.en: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

15:12.en: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

15:13.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
15:13.en: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before

15:14.ar: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ
15:14.en: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it

15:15.ar: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمࣱ مَّسۡحُورُونَ
15:15.en: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched

15:16.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجࣰ ا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
15:16.en: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders

15:17.en: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil

15:18.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
15:18.en: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue

15:19.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ مَّوۡزُونࣲ‏
15:19.en: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein

15:20.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
15:20.en: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not

15:21.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
15:21.en: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure

15:22.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
15:22.en: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof

15:23.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
15:23.en: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor

15:24.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ
15:24.en: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards

15:25.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
15:25.en: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware

15:26.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
15:26.en: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered

15:27.ar: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
15:27.en: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire

15:28.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
15:28.en: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered

15:29.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
15:29.en: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him

15:30.en: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

15:31.ar: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
15:31.en: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate

15:32.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
15:32.en: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate

15:33.ar: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ مِّنۡ حَمَإࣲ مَّسۡنُونࣲ‏
15:33.en: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered

15:34.en: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

15:35.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
15:35.en: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment

15:36.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
15:36.en: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

15:37.en: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

15:38.en: Till the Day of appointed time

15:39.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
15:39.en: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one

15:40.en: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves

15:41.en: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me

15:42.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
15:42.en: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee

15:43.en: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place

15:44.ar: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبࣲ لِّكُلِّ بَابࣲ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءࣱ مَّقۡسُومٌ
15:44.en: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion

15:45.en: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings

15:46.en: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure

15:47.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
15:47.en: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised

15:48.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبࣱ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ
15:48.en: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence

15:49.en: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful

15:50.en: And that My doom is the dolorous doom

15:51.en: And tell them of Abraham's guests

15:52.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ ا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ
15:52.en: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you

15:53.ar: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
15:53.en: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom

15:54.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
15:54.en: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings

15:55.ar: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ
15:55.en: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing

15:56.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
15:56.en: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray

15:57.en: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)

15:58.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
15:58.en: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk

15:59.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
15:59.en: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one

15:60.ar: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
15:60.en: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind

15:61.en: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot

16:1.ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
16:1.en: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him)

16:2.ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
16:2.en: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me

16:3.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
16:3.en: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him)

16:4.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
16:4.en: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent

16:5.ar: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءࣱ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
16:5.en: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat

16:6.ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ
16:6.en: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture

16:7.ar: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدࣲ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
16:7.en: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful

16:8.ar: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةࣰۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
16:8.en: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not

16:9.ar: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصۡدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرࣱۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
16:9.en: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright

16:10.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابࣱ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرࣱ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
16:10.en: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture

16:11.ar: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرۡعَ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
16:11.en: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect

16:12.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡقِلُونَ
16:12.en: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense

16:13.ar: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
16:13.en: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed

16:14.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمࣰ ا طَرِيࣰّ ا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةࣰ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
16:14.en: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks

16:15.ar: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا وَسُبُلࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
16:15.en: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way

16:16.en: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way

16:17.ar: أَفَمَن يَخۡلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخۡلُقُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
16:17.en: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember

16:18.ar: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
16:18.en: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful

16:19.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
16:19.en: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim

16:20.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ
16:20.en: Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created

16:21.ar: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءࣲۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
16:21.en: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised

16:22.ar: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةࣱ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
16:22.en: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud

16:23.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ
16:23.en: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud

16:24.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
16:24.en: And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old

16:25.ar: لِيَحۡمِلُوٓاْ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةࣰ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنۡ أَوۡزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
16:25.en: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear

16:26.ar: قَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنۡيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّقۡفُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
16:26.en: Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not

16:27.ar: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمۡۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ إِنَّ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
16:27.en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers

16:28.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ فَأَلۡقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُ مِن سُوٓءِۭۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
16:28.en: Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do

16:29.ar: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
16:29.en: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant

16:30.ar: ۞وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۚ قَالُواْ خَيۡرࣰ اۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣱۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرࣱۚ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
16:30.en: And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil)

16:31.ar: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
16:31.en: Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil)

16:32.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
16:32.en: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do

16:33.ar: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
16:33.en: Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves

16:34.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
16:34.en: So that the evils of what they did smote them, and that which they used to mock surrounded them

16:35.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءࣲ نَّحۡنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءࣲۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
16:35.en: And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)

16:36.ar: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
16:36.en: And verily We have raised in every nation a messenger, (proclaiming): Serve Allah and shun false gods. Then some of them (there were) whom Allah guided, and some of them (there were) upon whom error had just hold. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for the deniers

16:37.ar: إِن تَحۡرِصۡ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَن يُضِلُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
16:37.en: Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers

16:38.ar: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَا يَبۡعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُۚ بَلَىٰ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقࣰّ ا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
16:38.en: And they swear by Allah their most binding oaths (that) Allah will not raise up him who dieth. Nay, but it is a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not

16:39.ar: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰذِبِينَ
16:39.en: That He may explain unto them that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars

16:40.ar: إِنَّمَا قَوۡلُنَا لِشَيۡءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدۡنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
16:40.en: And Our word unto a thing, when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: Be! and it is

16:41.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰۖ وَلَأَجۡرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
16:41.en: And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew

16:42.en: Such as are steadfast and put their trust in Allah

16:43.ar: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالࣰ ا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
16:43.en: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not

16:44.ar: بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِۗ وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
16:44.en: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect

16:45.ar: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
16:45.en: Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not

16:46.ar: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
16:46.en: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them

16:47.ar: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفࣲ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
16:47.en: Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful

16:48.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءࣲ يَتَفَيَّؤُاْ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدࣰ ا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
16:48.en: Have they not observed all things that Allah hath created, how their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly

16:49.ar: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن دَآبَّةࣲ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
16:49.en: And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud

16:50.ar: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ۩
16:50.en: They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are bidden

16:51.ar: ۞وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ إِلَٰهَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ
16:51.en: Allah hath said: Choose not two gods. There is only One Allah. So of Me, Me only, be in awe

16:52.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًاۚ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
16:52.en: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah

16:53.ar: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعۡمَةࣲ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيۡهِ تَجۡـَٔرُونَ
16:53.en: And whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help

16:54.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقࣱ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
16:54.en: And afterward, when He hath rid you of the misfortune, behold! a set of you attribute partners to their Lord

16:55.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
16:55.en: So as to deny that which We have given them. Then enjoy life (while ye may), for ye will come to know

16:56.ar: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ نَصِيبࣰ ا مِّمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡتَرُونَ
16:56.en: And they assign a portion of that which We have given them unto what they know not. By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent

16:57.ar: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡبَنَٰتِ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
16:57.en: And they assign unto Allah daughters - Be He Glorified! - and unto themselves what they desire

16:58.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدࣰّ ا وَهُوَ كَظِيمࣱ‏
16:58.en: When if one of them receiveth tidings of the birth of a female, his face remaineth darkened, and he is wroth inwardly

16:59.ar: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓۚ أَيُمۡسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمۡ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
16:59.en: He hideth himself from the folk because of the evil of that whereof he hath had tidings, (asking himself): Shall he keep it in contempt, or bury it beneath the dust. Verily evil is their judgment

16:60.ar: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
16:60.en: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil similitude, and Allah's is the Sublime Similitude. He is the Mighty, the Wise

16:61.ar: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلۡمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيۡهَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّ ىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ سَاعَةࣰ وَلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُونَ
16:61.en: If Allah were to take mankind to task for their wrong-doing, he would not leave hereon a living creature, but He reprieveth them to an appointed term, and when their term cometh they cannot put (it) off an hour nor (yet) advance (it)

15:62.en: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me)

15:63.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
15:63.en: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing

15:64.en: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers

15:65.ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعࣲ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدࣱ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ
15:65.en: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded

15:66.ar: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعࣱ مُّصۡبِحِينَ
15:66.en: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn

15:67.en: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals)

15:68.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ
15:68.en: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not

15:69.en: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not

15:70.en: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone

15:71.ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
15:71.en: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so)

15:72.en: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death

15:73.en: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise

15:74.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
15:74.en: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay

15:75.en: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs

15:76.en: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced

15:77.en: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers

15:78.en: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers

15:79.en: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see

15:80.en: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers

15:81.en: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them

15:82.ar: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
15:82.en: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure

15:83.en: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour

15:84.ar: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
15:84.en: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not

15:85.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةࣱۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ
15:85.en: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness

15:86.en: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator

15:87.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ
15:87.en: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an

15:88.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
15:88.en: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers

15:89.en: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner

15:90.en: Such as We send down for those who make division

15:91.en: Those who break the Qur'an into parts

15:92.en: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one

15:93.en: Of what they used to do

15:94.ar: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
15:94.en: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters

15:95.en: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers

15:96.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
15:96.en: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know

15:97.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
15:97.en: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say

15:98.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
15:98.en: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him)

15:99.en: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee

16:64.ar: وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ وَهُدࣰ ى وَرَحۡمَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
16:64.en: And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe

16:65.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَسۡمَعُونَ
16:65.en: Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear

16:66.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةࣰۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثࣲ وَدَمࣲ لَّبَنًا خَالِصࣰ ا سَآئِغࣰ ا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
16:66.en: And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers

16:67.ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرࣰ ا وَرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡقِلُونَ
16:67.en: And of the fruits of the date-palm, and grapes, whence ye derive strong drink and (also) good nourishment. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who have sense

16:68.ar: وَأَوۡحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحۡلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِي مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُونَ
16:68.en: And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch

16:69.ar: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسۡلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلࣰ اۚ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابࣱ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءࣱ لِّلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
16:69.en: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect

16:70.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمۡۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمࣲ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمࣱ قَدِيرࣱ‏
16:70.en: And Allah createth you, then causeth you to die, and among you is he who is brought back to the most abject stage of life, so that he knoweth nothing after (having had) knowledge. Lo! Allah is Knower, Powerful

16:71.ar: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فِي ٱلرِّزۡقِۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُواْ بِرَآدِّي رِزۡقِهِمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌۚ أَفَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ
16:71.en: And Allah hath favoured some of you above others in provision. Now those who are more favoured will by no means hand over their provision to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Is it then the grace of Allah that they deny

16:72.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةࣰ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ
16:72.en: And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve

16:73.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
16:73.en: And they worship beside Allah that which owneth no provision whatsoever for them from the heavens or the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power

16:74.ar: فَلَا تَضۡرِبُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
16:74.en: So coin not similitudes for Allah. Lo! Allah knoweth; ye know not

16:78.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَخۡرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
16:78.en: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks

16:79.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتࣲ فِي جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
16:79.en: Have they not seen the birds obedient in mid-air? None holdeth them save Allah. Lo! herein, verily, are portents for a people who believe

16:80.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ سَكَنࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بُيُوتࣰ ا تَسۡتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوۡمَ ظَعۡنِكُمۡ وَيَوۡمَ إِقَامَتِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَصۡوَافِهَا وَأَوۡبَارِهَا وَأَشۡعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثࣰ ا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
16:80.en: And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while

16:81.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ أَكۡنَٰنࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلۡحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأۡسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡلِمُونَ
16:81.en: And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him)

16:82.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
16:82.en: Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message)

16:83.ar: يَعۡرِفُونَ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
16:83.en: They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates

16:84.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ شَهِيدࣰ ا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
16:84.en: And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends

16:85.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
16:85.en: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved

16:86.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ شُرَكَآءَهُمۡ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِكَۖ فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ إِنَّكُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
16:86.en: And when those who ascribed partners to Allah behold those partners of theirs, they will say: Our Lord! these are our partners unto whom we used to cry instead of Thee. But they will fling to them the saying: Lo! ye verily are liars

16:87.ar: وَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
16:87.en: And they proffer unto Allah submission on that day, and all that they used to invent hath failed them

16:88.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدۡنَٰهُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا فَوۡقَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يُفۡسِدُونَ
16:88.en: For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption

16:89.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ تِبۡيَٰنࣰ ا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَهُدࣰ ى وَرَحۡمَةࣰ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
16:89.en: And (bethink you of) the day when We raise in every nation a witness against them of their own folk, and We bring thee (Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We reveal the Scripture unto thee as an exposition of all things, and a guidance and a mercy and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah)

16:90.ar: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآيِٕ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
16:90.en: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed

16:91.ar: وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمۡ وَلَا تَنقُضُواْ ٱلۡأَيۡمَٰنَ بَعۡدَ تَوۡكِيدِهَا وَقَدۡ جَعَلۡتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَفِيلًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
16:91.en: Fulfil the covenant of Allah when ye have covenanted, and break not your oaths after the asseveration of them, and after ye have made Allah surety over you. Lo! Allah knoweth what ye do

16:103.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرࣱۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِي يُلۡحِدُونَ إِلَيۡهِ أَعۡجَمِيࣱّ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيࣱّ مُّبِينٌ
16:103.en: And We know well that they say: Only a man teacheth him. The speech of him at whom they falsely hint is outlandish, and this is clear Arabic speech

16:111.ar: ۞يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ تُجَٰدِلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
16:111.en: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, and every soul will be repaid what it did, and they will not be wronged

16:120.ar: إِنَّ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةࣰ قَانِتࣰ ا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفࣰ ا وَلَمۡ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
16:120.en: Lo! Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, by nature upright, and he was not of the idolaters

16:121.ar: شَاكِرࣰ ا لِّأَنۡعُمِهِۚ ٱجۡتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
16:121.en: Thankful for His bounties; He chose him and He guided him unto a straight path

16:122.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
16:122.en: And We gave him good in the world, and in the Hereafter he is among the righteous

16:123.ar: ثُمَّ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفࣰ اۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
16:123.en: And afterward We inspired thee (Muhammad, saying): Follow the religion of Abraham, as one by nature upright. He was not of the idolaters

16:125.ar: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
16:125.en: Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright

16:126.ar: وَإِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُواْ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبۡتُم بِهِۦۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرࣱ لِّلصَّٰبِرِينَ
16:126.en: If ye punish, then punish with the like of that wherewith ye were afflicted. But if ye endure patiently, verily it is better for the patient

16:127.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقࣲ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ
16:127.en: Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad). Thine endurance is only by (the help of) Allah. Grieve not for them, and be not in distress because of that which they devise

16:128.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ
16:128.en: Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good

7:16.ar: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأَقۡعُدَنَّ لَهُمۡ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
7:16.en: He said: Now, because Thou hast sent me astray, verily I shall lurk in ambush for them on Thy Right Path

7:17.ar: ثُمَّ لَأٓتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ وَعَنۡ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمۡۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ شَٰكِرِينَ
7:17.en: Then I shall come upon them from before them and from behind them and from their right hands and from their left hands, and Thou wilt not find most of them beholden (unto Thee)

17:44.ar: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبۡعُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفۡقَهُونَ تَسۡبِيحَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورࣰ ا
17:44.en: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving

GrkPd59mI2w.speaker: adnan
GrkPd59mI2w.speaker_note: the sheikh's own A Juz A Day series; single voice throughout
GrkPd59mI2w.title: A Juz A Day, Juz 14: Recognize Allah and Thank Him
GrkPd59mI2w.one_line: Surat al-Hijr and Surat an-Nahl: Allah's provision and countless favours in creation, and the gratitude, gentleness and patience they should produce.
GrkPd59mI2w.summary: Covering al-Hijr and an-Nahl, he argues that recognizing Allah through creation must lead to thanking Him. In al-Hijr, demands for angels and miracles are exposed as excuses from people unwilling to change their lives. Allah presents Himself as the Provider who feeds every creature and inherits everything. Retelling Adam and Iblis, he stresses that Satan works by making sin alluring and has no power over devoted servants. He reads the stories of Ibrahim's guests, Lut and Thamud, noting the protector's role and why the Quran gives detail only where the audience lacks it. The surah's close teaches that people are moved more by gracious conduct than by arguments, warns against a wandering eye that belittles one's blessings, and gives a spiritual remedy for hurtful words: glorification, prayer and the community of believers. In an-Nahl he dwells on cattle, horses, sea, stars, milk and honey, insisting that Islam values beauty as well as function. He condemns contempt for daughters, explains why Allah delays punishment, and ends with justice and ihsan, inviting with wisdom and courteous argument, and choosing patience over retaliation.

outline.heading: Opening
Let them enjoy: a day they will wish they had submitted
outline.gist: A zoomed-out view: rejecters will wish they were Muslims on the Last Day, and every nation's term is fixed.

outline.heading: Mocking demand for angels
outline.gist: Quraysh call the Prophet mad and ask for angels, but angels of that kind come only with punishment.

outline.heading: Allah guards the Quran; every messenger was mocked
outline.gist: Allah protects His book; rejecters let the greatest privilege, seeing a prophet, slip through their hearts.

outline.heading: Even a gateway into the sky would not convince them
outline.gist: Miracle demands are a misdirection, because belief would force them to change priorities and business ethics.

outline.heading: Allah the Provider for every creature
outline.gist: Constellations, the spread earth and its balanced growth; Allah provides for creatures in every environment from storehouses sent down in measure.

outline.heading: Pollinating winds and water from the sky
outline.gist: The winds that pollinate set off a whole ecosystem, and water sustains it.

outline.heading: Allah inherits everything: creation points to resurrection
outline.gist: Allah speaks in the plural of majesty; He was before creation and remains after it, and creation is always paired with resurrection.

outline.heading: Adam and Iblis in al-Hijr
outline.gist: The breath of the spirit sets humans apart; Iblis refuses, is expelled, and blames Allah for his own choice.

outline.heading: Satan's strategy: making evil alluring
outline.gist: Al-A'raf says where he attacks, al-Hijr how; he has no power over Allah's devoted servants.

outline.heading: The seven gates of hell
outline.gist: Each gate takes its share according to the categories of evil done.

outline.heading: Peace, safety and a clean heart: paradise before paradise
outline.gist: Gardens entered in peace, hearts cleared of bitterness; a person who achieves this on earth tastes paradise early.

outline.heading: Forgiving and merciful; punishment as justice
outline.gist: Allah names Himself the Forgiving and the Merciful but speaks of punishment separately, showing it is justice rather than His nature.

outline.heading: Ibrahim's guests and the news of a son
outline.gist: Ibrahim's question was wonder at an unnatural event, not despair; only the misguided despair of Allah's mercy.

outline.heading: Lut's household saved, his wife excepted
outline.gist: The angels are sent to a guilty people with an exception for Lut's family, from which his wife is removed for her betrayal.

outline.heading: Walking behind them: the protector's role
outline.gist: Lut is told to walk behind his family, between them and the threat, highlighting the man's duty to provide and protect.

outline.heading: The people of Lut and their punishment
outline.gist: They dismiss Lut's plea for his guests, drunk on desire, until the blast and the overturned city.

outline.heading: Forest dwellers and Thamud: why the Quran names some places
outline.gist: Places of prophets unknown to the Bible are named for context, while familiar ones are not; their buildings did not save them.

outline.heading: The closing passage of al-Hijr
outline.gist: He reads the passage on purposeful creation, gracious patience, the seven oft-repeated verses and worship until certainty.

outline.heading: Ordered creation leads to a Creator, worship and resurrection
outline.gist: A sound fitrah pondering the cosmos must conclude there is a Creator who will hold us to account.

outline.heading: Bear with them graciously: conduct as dawah
outline.gist: Most people are moved by behaviour more than by argument, so the believer's good character brings people to Islam.

outline.heading: No wandering eye; gentleness with believers
outline.gist: The Fatihah and the Quran are the greatest gift; longing for others' blessings erodes gratitude, and believers must be gentle with each other.

outline.heading: A spiritual remedy for hurtful words
outline.gist: Beside advocacy, the response to hurt is glorifying Allah, praying with the believers and worshipping until certainty comes.

outline.heading: An-Nahl: the command of Allah is at hand
outline.gist: Do not hasten the Day; the surah's theme is recognizing Allah and thanking Him.

outline.heading: From a drop of fluid to an open challenger
outline.gist: Creation has purpose, and the irony is that a human made from a drop disputes his Maker.

outline.heading: Cattle and riding animals: function and beauty
outline.gist: Livestock give food, warmth and transport, and Allah also points to the beauty of herds and horses.

outline.heading: Islam embraces beauty
outline.gist: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty; a companion known for his fragrance shows beauty is part of the deen. Allah creates what we do not yet know.

outline.heading: Rain, crops and a subjected cosmos
outline.gist: He shows the way while leaving the choice; rain, fruit, day and night and stars are subjected for human benefit.

outline.heading: The sea: food, ornaments and ships
outline.gist: The sea gives food and beauty such as pearls; the purpose of using these favours is gratitude.

outline.heading: Mountains and landmarks; blessings beyond counting
outline.gist: Can the One who creates equal those who create nothing? Allah's favours cannot be counted, so are we truly thankful?

outline.heading: 'Ancient fables': carrying the burdens of those misled
outline.gist: Influential rejecters bear their own sins and those of the people they led astray.

outline.heading: The believers' answer and the angels' greeting at death
outline.gist: Believers say what was revealed is all good; at the hardest moment of death angels greet the righteous with peace.

outline.heading: The tired excuse of forefathers and Allah's will
outline.gist: People make choices about everything else, so blaming inherited faith on Allah is a misdirection.

outline.heading: A messenger to every nation
outline.gist: Shared morals across peoples reflect one message: worship Allah and shun false gods. Guidance is a gift.

outline.heading: Shadows bow to Allah
outline.gist: 'Be, and it is'; shadows shifting with the sun are a form of prostration.

outline.heading: All creation prostrates: worship as harmony
outline.gist: Trees, creatures and angels submit; Allah does not need our worship, but choosing it puts us in harmony with everything around us.

outline.heading: Daughters are a gift, not a disgrace
outline.gist: The pagan dread of baby girls shows how shirk corrupts morality; daughters raised well are a way to paradise.

outline.heading: Why punishment is delayed: the appointed term
outline.gist: If Allah punished at once no one would remain; life is a chance to repent, and death ends the chances.

outline.heading: The Prophet explains the Quran; rain revives dead earth
outline.gist: The sunnah is the Prophet explaining and living the Quran; reviving dead land parallels resurrection.

outline.heading: Pure milk from between dung and blood
outline.gist: Allah draws purity from the midst of impurity.

outline.heading: Fruits turned into intoxicants or provision
outline.gist: People can turn pure provision into something evil.

outline.heading: The honeybee
outline.gist: The bee is inspired to build and feed, and from its belly comes honey of many colours with healing.

outline.heading: Life stages, provision and generations of family
outline.gist: Strength rises and declines, provision differs, and spouses, children and grandchildren form a system of favours; how then worship the powerless?

outline.heading: Born knowing nothing; birds held in the sky
outline.gist: Hearing, sight and intellect given to helpless infants, and the flight of birds, are starting points for faith.

outline.heading: Homes, tents, shade and clothing
outline.gist: Human materials copy what Allah placed in nature; these favours aim at full submission.

outline.heading: A witness from every community
outline.gist: Each nation's prophet testifies; false gods disown their worshippers, and the Prophet witnesses over all.

outline.heading: Justice, ihsan and generosity to kin
outline.gist: Three commands and three prohibitions; aggression is the opposite of justice.

outline.heading: The plagiarism charge and the foreign tongue
outline.gist: Borrowed material always sounds foreign, but the Quran is pristine Arabic from a Prophet who could not read.

outline.heading: Every soul pleads for itself; Ibrahim the grateful
outline.gist: The surah ends by holding up Ibrahim, utterly grateful for Allah's favours, as the model Quraysh claim descent from.

outline.heading: Invite with wisdom; argue in the best way
outline.gist: Dawah must be wise and sensible, and even debate must stay courteous, without mudslinging or crude jokes.

outline.heading: Retaliate only in equal measure; patience is best
outline.gist: Forgiving and enduring is better than revenge, and patience comes only with Allah's help.

outline.heading: Outro

8:62.ar: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسۡبَكَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَبِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

8:63.ar: وَأَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ لَوۡ أَنفَقۡتَ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا مَّآ أَلَّفۡتَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏

3:103.ar: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعࣰ ا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُواْۚ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ كُنتُمۡ أَعۡدَآءࣰ فَأَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم بِنِعۡمَتِهِۦٓ إِخۡوَٰنࣰ ا وَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفۡرَةࣲ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنۡهَاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
3:103.en: And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided

3:105.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُواْ وَٱخۡتَلَفُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمࣱ‏
3:105.en: And be ye not as those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs had come unto them. For such there is an awful doom

SuWirnjanys.title: The Values of Islam: Brotherhood and Unity (Ukhuwwah and Jama'ah)
SuWirnjanys.one_line: Brotherhood is the bond and unity is the structure it builds; without both, Muslims are a crowd that fragments and falls.
SuWirnjanys.summary: Closing the run of social values in his Ramadan series, he pairs brotherhood and unity as two values that cannot work apart. Brotherhood is like the bond between molecules and unity the stable structure that results; brotherhood without unity produces purposeless friendships, and unity without brotherhood becomes authoritarian conformity. He argues Muslims in the West are a crowd rather than a community unless they centralize something, and of the four options (political, social, religious, financial) only pooling zakat and endowments is realistic. He grounds the value in the Quran's statement that believers are brothers, the one-body hadith and the Prophet's pairing of Muhajirun and Ansar in Madinah, which he calls one of the miracles of prophethood. He separates healthy scholarly disagreement from destructive factionalism, insisting on unity rather than uniformity, and mocks the group-within-a-group habit that makes people belong to a faction instead of Islam. Masajid must welcome everyone as hosts in Allah's house, and congregational prayer and dua show that even the most intimate worship is done together. He ends with the fall of Muslim Spain as the lesson of petty fragmentation and asks Muslims to get over themselves and work with one another.

outline.heading: Opening
Social values versus personal values
outline.gist: He has covered values that shape relations between people and will turn to personal ones next; today's two values are deeply interdependent.

outline.heading: Brotherhood as bond, unity as structure
outline.gist: Brotherhood is the molecular bond and jama'ah the stable structure it forms, built from two people up to the whole ummah.

outline.heading: Losing one ruins the other
outline.gist: Brotherhood without unity gives purposeless friendships; unity without brotherhood gives authoritarian conformity.

outline.heading: A family versus a crowd
outline.gist: What turns a group of people into a community is the moral and emotional bond and the cohesion that lets it channel its energy.

outline.heading: Centralizing politics: not available in the West
outline.gist: Many jama'ah hadith assume a political imam, so in the West they must be read figuratively because Muslims cannot have that structure.

outline.heading: Centralizing socially: Muslims live scattered
outline.gist: Unlike Little Italy or Chinatown, Muslims here do not cluster, which he counts as a positive trait of blending in and working with everyone.

outline.heading: Centralizing religiously: still a dream
outline.gist: Unified religious leadership is the ideal but he does not believe it is achievable now.

outline.heading: Centralizing finances: the one real option
outline.gist: Pooling zakat and endowments is the only realistic way to turn Muslims here into a community rather than a crowd.

outline.heading: Believers are brothers: a fact, not a preference
outline.gist: The Quran states brotherhood as an ethical fact, and the Prophet described believers as one body and forbade enmity, desertion and oppression.

outline.heading: Looking down on a brother, and Allah uniting hearts
outline.gist: Contempt for a fellow Muslim is enough evil for a lifetime; Allah, not money, joined the believers' hearts.

outline.heading: The Madinah brotherhood as a miracle
outline.gist: Pairing Muhajirun with Ansar in shared homes, sometimes for a decade, was unheard of among Arabs and is one of the miracles of prophethood.

outline.heading: Your team, for better or worse
outline.gist: Like a child placed on a soccer team, you do not choose your fellow Muslims; you build the bond so the team works.

outline.heading: Unity, not uniformity
outline.gist: Scholarly disagreement is built into Islam and he defends opinions he rejects; the evil is factionalism that destroys cooperation.

outline.heading: Quran and hadith against division
outline.gist: Allah repeatedly commands holding together and warns against splitting like earlier peoples; the Prophet's hadith on the jama'ah are emphatic and even harsh.

outline.heading: The group-within-a-group phenomenon
outline.gist: Saying the shahadah is enough to belong; sub-groups that duplicate everything and claim to have it all figured out fragment the ummah, as he saw growing up.

outline.heading: Masajid as Allah's house: welcome everyone
outline.gist: Those serving the masjid are hosts on Allah's behalf and must welcome every visitor without checklists, as they would guests in their own home.

outline.heading: Congregational salah and dua
outline.gist: Even prayer, the most intimate act, is done in straight equal rows regardless of wealth, age or colour, and dua is made together.

outline.heading: Concentrated energy and a global ummah
outline.gist: A cohesive ummah multiplies its impact, and Muslims everywhere praying for each other is a bond that transcends race, nation and wealth.

outline.heading: Shaytan's aim: fragmentation
outline.gist: Every split halves strength; history repeatedly shows egocentric Muslim factions falling one after another.

outline.heading: The fall of Al-Andalus
outline.gist: Nearly a millennium of civilization and knowledge was lost through petty, egoistic division, down to the language itself.

outline.heading: Holding on when there is no jama'ah
outline.gist: The hadith of clinging to the root of a tree shows that without unity Muslims become sitting ducks, as events overseas show today.

outline.heading: Outro
